_note: Relics. Each effect key is summed across owned relics (sim/run_state.gd mod()) and read by the rule it names; most of the newer relics change a rule rather than a number, so the numbers in their effects are the rule's knobs. tags: "spoils" marks the spoils of a beaten warband: never in the ordinary pool, one is added to the offer after a round, for an enemy tag (spoils_of) the round's attack was made of (sim/run_state.gd _roll_spoils). take_now (spoils only): what taking it brings at once, folk (role -> how many join) and per_foe (good -> amount per enemy of that kind in the attack); spoils with no effects are only take_now, so they can be offered again and are not kept as relics. "pact" marks a strong relic with a real cost, offered only on pact_rounds (data/balance.json) the way Slay the Spire offers boss relics; other rounds offer the rest. from_round: not offered before that round (relics whose enemies come later). Effect keys by area: picks and cards (pick_bonus, hand_bonus, extra_picks, twin_every, no_redraw), relics (gain_relics, relic_choices), economy (trade_deals, trade_rarity, barter_bonus: the caravan's trade cards, data/trades.json; income, income_mult, hero_tithe, interest, interest_cap, kill_shells, kill_fuel, hearth_per_safe_round), waves (no_catch_up, no_probes, wave_mult, one_side), townsfolk (warrior_hp, warrior_attack, horde_damage, horde_per, turncoat_chance, turncoat_max, risen_per_night, levy), heroes (hero_attack, hero_hp, xp_mult, lone_heroes, lone_damage, lone_tire, chosen_xp, others_xp, mourning_share, trophy_every, trophy_damage, curse_lift, cursed_drops, kin_damage, kin_radius, night_damage, day_damage), enemies (beast_peace, siege_thorns), ventures (venture_safety, venture_bonus; data/ventures.json), earth (earth_turns: the near ring turns that many plates more between rounds, still_ring: it never turns). tag-keyed effects map a tag to the effect, so a relic covers every entity that carries the tag, new content included (RunState.tag_mod / tag_sums): foe_damage {tag: share} = heroes and townsfolk hit enemies with that tag that much harder; foe_spoils {tag: {good: amount}} = goods for the town each time such an enemy falls; gear_bonus {tag: {stat: per tier}} = gear whose base carries the tag gains that stat per tier, and heroes rate it that much higher (Loot.stat); node_yield {tag: share} = gatherers bring that much more from nodes with the tag, and plan their trips by it; plate_knobs {tag: {knob: add}} = adds to the numbers of every near plate kind with the tag (data/plates.json near_kinds: walk, raider_walk, sight, regrow, rise_chance, grave_goods; Earth.kind_def), and buildings may carry it too. rarity (data/rarity.json): white = a plain number, blue = a stronger or slower-building one, yellow = changes a rule, orange = a pact or a mythic relic (strong with no cost, offered late and rarely); no rarity means white. Ordinary offers are drawn weighted by rarity odds (data/balance.json rarity_climb).

blood_oath.name: Blood Oath
blood_oath.text: Heroes deal +4 damage. Hearth -30 max HP.

seed_cache.name: Seed Cache
seed_cache.text: +1 food per day for every round you have owned it.

bear_tooth_charm.name: Bear-tooth Charm
bear_tooth_charm.text: Heroes +10 max HP and retreat later.

fire_arrows.name: Fire Arrows
fire_arrows.text: Hearth and watch posts deal +4 damage.

sacred_spring.name: Sacred Spring
sacred_spring.text: Heroes heal fully between rounds and 3x faster at the hearth.

ember_stone.name: Ember Stone
ember_stone.text: The hearth burns 1 less fuel each night.

bone_dice.name: Bone Dice
bone_dice.text: Every kill drops +2 shells for the hero.

chieftains_torc.name: Chieftain's Torc
chieftains_torc.text: Every blueprint draft offers 1 more building and you can never reroll it. Dawn picks show one card fewer.

twin_fires.name: Twin Fires
twin_fires.text: Take two newcomers at every dawn, but the hearth burns twice the fuel.

broken_crown.name: Broken Crown
broken_crown.text: Gain 2 random relics now. Later relic offers show one card fewer.

tithe_bowl.name: Tithe Bowl
tithe_bowl.text: Traders stop leaving shells. Instead the town takes a third of every shell heroes earn from kills.

black_banner.name: Black Banner
black_banner.text: Waves never hold back for a weak town, but every enemy killed pays the town 2 shells.

hollow_drum.name: Hollow Drum
hollow_drum.text: No small raids on the first two nights. The warned wave comes a third larger.

lodestone_wheel.name: Lodestone Wheel
lodestone_wheel.text: The near ring turns two plates between rounds instead of one, so the attack's ground changes faster.

horde_drum.name: Horde Drum
horde_drum.text: Warriors deal +1 damage for every 3 other warriors in town.

turncoats_torc.name: Turncoat's Torc
turncoats_torc.text: A human raider brought low may throw down arms and join you as a warrior (1 in 6, at most 2 a night).

bone_flute.name: Bone Flute
bone_flute.text: Each night the first 3 enemies to fall rise as skeletons that fight for the town until dawn.

levy_horn.name: Levy Horn
levy_horn.text: On the warned night tribespeople take up spears: they fight raiders near the camp and hit as hard as warriors.

hearth_mothers_doll.name: Hearth-mother's Doll
hearth_mothers_doll.text: Every 3rd townsperson you take at dawn brings a twin.

carrion_kiln.name: Carrion Kiln
carrion_kiln.text: Every enemy that dies inside the settlement burns for 1 fuel.

lone_wolf_pelt.name: Lone Wolf's Pelt
lone_wolf_pelt.text: While you have 2 heroes or fewer, they deal double damage and tire half as fast.

chosen_brand.name: Chosen One's Brand
chosen_brand.text: Your highest-level hero gains triple XP. The others gain half.

mourning_bell.name: Mourning Bell
mourning_bell.text: When a hero dies, the others share all the XP they ever earned and don't grieve.

trophy_belt.name: Trophy Belt
trophy_belt.text: Every 10 kills, a hero gains +1 damage for good.

witchs_thread.name: Witch's Thread
witchs_thread.text: Cursed gear loses its HP penalty, and a third of the gear heroes find comes cursed.

blood_brother_knot.name: Blood-brother Knot
blood_brother_knot.text: A hero fighting near another hero deals 30% more damage.

owl_eyes.name: Owl Eyes
owl_eyes.text: Heroes deal 50% more damage at night and 25% less by day.

wolf_mothers_skull.name: Wolf-mother's Skull
wolf_mothers_skull.text: Beasts leave townsfolk alone unless a townsperson strikes them first.

grave_salt.name: Grave Salt
grave_salt.text: Undead take double damage from heroes and townsfolk.

ram_thorn_stakes.name: Ram-thorn Stakes
ram_thorn_stakes.text: Siege engines take 10 damage every time they strike a gate or the hearth.

beacon_pyre.name: Beacon Pyre
beacon_pyre.text: The warned wave always comes from one side only.

stillstone.name: Stillstone
stillstone.text: The near ring of plates stops turning, so the attack keeps crossing the same ground.

caravan_seal.name: Caravan Seal
caravan_seal.text: The southern caravan lays out 1 more deal, and rare deals come twice as often.

hagglers_scales.name: Haggler's Scales
hagglers_scales.text: Barter deals at the caravan bring half as much again.

moneylenders_knot.name: Moneylender's Knot
moneylenders_knot.text: Each round, shells you hold earn 10% interest (at most 25).

sun_disc.name: Sun Disc
sun_disc.text: Heroes deal +3 damage and have +15 max HP.

antler_crown.name: Antler Crown
antler_crown.text: Take two newcomers at every dawn.

first_hearth_ember.name: Ember of the First Hearth
first_hearth_ember.text: Hearth +60 max HP, and it burns 1 less fuel each night.

ancestors_horn.name: Ancestors' Horn
ancestors_horn.text: Warriors +20 max HP and +3 damage, and on the warned night tribespeople take up spears beside them.

blood_mark.name: Hunter's Blood-mark
blood_mark.text: Heroes and townsfolk deal 40% more damage to beasts.

kinslayers_brand.name: Kinslayer's Brand
kinslayers_brand.text: Heroes and townsfolk deal 30% more damage to humans.

spirit_knot.name: Spirit-knot
spirit_knot.text: Heroes and townsfolk deal 60% more damage to mystic and spirit foes (bone-callers, the Antlered King).

skinning_knife.name: Skinning Knife
skinning_knife.text: Every beast that falls gives the town 2 food and 1 hides.

ossuary_pit.name: Ossuary Pit
ossuary_pit.text: Every undead that falls gives the town 3 bone, and every human 1.

knappers_spirit.name: Knapper's Spirit
knappers_spirit.text: Stone gear (flint, obsidian) deals +1 damage per tier. Heroes favour it.

bone_readers_rite.name: Bone-reader's Rite
bone_readers_rite.text: Bone gear (spears, claw and antler charms) deals +1 damage per tier. Heroes favour it.

tanners_blessing.name: Tanner's Blessing
tanners_blessing.text: Hide gear (armour, cloaks) gives +6 health per tier. Heroes favour it.

smith_gods_hammer.name: Smith-god's Hammer
smith_gods_hammer.text: Bronze and iron gear deals +1 damage and gives +4 health per tier. Heroes favour it.

quarry_spirit.name: Quarry Spirit
quarry_spirit.text: Gatherers bring home half again from stony ground (rocks, flint, obsidian).

green_mothers_bough.name: Green Mother's Bough
green_mothers_bough.text: Gatherers bring home 40% more from growing things (brush, berries, groves).

ore_singer.name: Ore-singer's Drum
ore_singer.text: Gatherers bring home twice as much ore (copper, tin, bog iron).

ancestor_bones.name: Ancestor Bones
ancestor_bones.text: The hearth gains 6 max HP after every round in which nobody died.

pathfinders_cord.name: Pathfinder's Cord
pathfinders_cord.text: Ventures lose 1 fewer tribesperson and bring home a third more.

raiders_spears.name: Raiders' Spears
raiders_spears.text: Warriors fight with the raiders' spears: +2 attack. One raider who threw down his spear joins as a warrior now.

pack_train.name: Captured Pack-train
pack_train.text: Take what the raiders carried: shells and wood for every raider who came.

wolfskin_cloaks.name: Wolfskin Cloaks
wolfskin_cloaks.text: Cloaks from the pack's hides: heroes +6 health, warriors +8 health.

smoked_haunches.name: Smoked Haunches
smoked_haunches.text: Butcher the fallen beasts: food for every beast that came.

grave_goods.name: Grave Goods
grave_goods.text: Rob the barrow-dead of what they were buried with: shells for every one that came.

bone_ward.name: Bone Ward
bone_ward.text: Their own bones, hung at the gates: undead take 50% more damage from heroes and townsfolk.

ram_timbers.name: Ram Timbers
ram_timbers.text: Break up the battering rams: wood and stone for every ram that came.

splintered_ram.name: Splintered Ram
splintered_ram.text: Its splinters line the gates: siege engines take 5 damage every time they strike a gate or the hearth.

bog_drowners_stake.name: Bog-drowner's Stake
bog_drowners_stake.text: Raiders wade the Fen a fifth slower still, and your people don't.

thorn_witchs_veil.name: Thorn-witch's Veil
thorn_witchs_veil.text: The Greenwood hides raiders less (towers and the hearth see them a quarter farther) and regrows a tenth more each dawn.

cairn_wardens_cord.name: Cairn-warden's Cord
cairn_wardens_cord.text: Raiders lose the Stonefield's quick going, and towers see a little farther across it.

barrow_kings_lamp.name: Barrow-king's Lamp
barrow_kings_lamp.text: The dead stay down on the Barrow, and heroes who kill there dig up grave goods twice as often.
